questions.learningObjective: Apply social movement to a study of social movement.

stimulus.body: In 2005 a survey of 450 retirees in West Africa found 58% supported a reform movement, while 30% opposed it.

questions.stem: Explain the 2005 Africa finding about social movement.

answer.exemplar: In 2005 a survey of 450 retirees in West Africa found 58% supported a reform movement, while 30% opposed it. This illustrates social movement: a sustained, organized effort to bring about or resist social change. A careful reading links the group-level pattern to the wider social structure rather than to any single person, and it distinguishes this idea from competing accounts that locate the cause elsewhere.

questions.explanation: The finding illustrates social movement: a sustained, organized effort to bring about or resist social change. The 58 percent versus 30 percent split in West Africa shows why this reading fits better than the alternatives.
questions.hint: Think about the social force behind the two figures.
